hook.text: The EU's carbon border tax charges imports from dirty factories. Cleaner nations love it. Poorer ones cry unfair.

buildup.text: CBAM taxes imported goods based on their carbon footprint. Steel from a coal-fueled plant pays more at the border.

discovery.text: The tax prevents carbon leakage — factories moving to places with weaker rules. It levels the green playing field.

twist.text: Developing nations call it green protectionism.

climax.text: If the US and EU both implement carbon borders, trade blocs may split between green and brown economies.

punchline.text: Climate policy is becoming trade policy in disguise.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of a carbon border adjustment mechanism?
options: To fund renewable energy projects in developing nations
To prevent factories from moving to countries with weaker climate rules
To ban all imports from high-emission countries
